scope: Coordinator personally reread all five complete original reports before opening detailed proposed-errata JSON. Candidate UIDs/targets and proposed mask direction were known from triage message. This is a targeted independent adjudication, not a new blinded whole-batch preread.
interpretation: Conservative weak-supervision masking under unresolved grading convention; not a claim that the original clinical grade means high-grade disease. Modern depth-based Outerbridge and official ICRS can support negative grade2 when that convention is established.

records.source_evidence: Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
records.reason: Diffuse partial-thickness patellar ulcers are described, but their depth fraction and grading convention are unstated. Grade2 alone is compatible with a below-threshold interpretation but does not explicitly bind it here.
Moderate patellar thinning and unspecified grade2 do not state a depth fraction or named grading convention. Normal trochlear cartilage does not resolve the patellar depth.

records.source_evidence: Condropatía lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la rótula.
records.reason: Patellar partial-thickness ulcers have unspecified depth. The explicit superficial descriptor applies to lateral tibial plateau, not patella, and must not be transferred. Mixed grade1/2 does not resolve unnamed grade2 depth.

records.source_evidence: Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
records.reason: Diffuse patellar partial-thickness ulcers have unquantified depth and an unnamed grade2 convention. A reliable negative cannot be established independently of that convention.
Only mixed patellar gradeI/II is given without a named convention or direct depth description. Retain the uncertainty instead of silently assuming the meaning of gradeII.
